name: context-menu
title: Context menu
description: The actions for what is under the pointer, opened by a right-click, a long press or Shift+F10.

when: Rows, cards or a canvas where people expect right-click actions.

instead.when: The actions belong to a visible button.

guidance.rule: Never the only way to an action: put it in a visible Menu too.
Same order as the row's menu.

builtIn: Opens at the pointer, or under the focused element with Shift+F10 or the Menu key; focus goes back on close.
youProvide: With children: a textValue on a MenuItem whose label is not plain text, so typing can jump to it; the destructive item last, after a MenuSeparator.

ContextMenu.name: children
ContextMenu.description:
The region a right-click, a long press or Shift+F10 opens the menu on: a row, a card, a canvas. Or, to compose
the menu from parts: a `ContextMenuTrigger` holding that region, followed by `MenuItem`, `MenuSection`,
`MenuSubmenu` and `MenuSeparator`.

ContextMenu.name: items
ContextMenu.description: The menu as data; leave it out when composing with a `ContextMenuTrigger`.

ContextMenuTrigger.name: children
ContextMenuTrigger.description: The region that opens the menu.
